notes:
CRM notes / call summary (shorthand):
- Company: Arcadian Assistive Labs — B2B SaaS for customer success automation. 300 agents across NA+EU.
- Primary goal: Replace legacy bot with real-time agent-assist + autonomous actions (tool calls into CRM, order lookup).
- Workload: high-concurrency chat with streaming responses, tool calling required for CRM lookups and ticket updates. Emphasis on 1st-token latency <1.5s for live agent handoff.
- POC plan: Stage 1 = Hosted API POC (2 weeks): integrate streaming + tool calling, measure first-token distribution and tail latency; Stage 2 = if SLO fail, run Dedicated sizing + pricing (reserved).
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; willing to pay premium for consistent latency and SLA but wants clear unit economics; quoted ARR target $50-150k.
- Model preferences: open to Redwood-curated LLMs (optimize for low-latency variant), prefer 8-bit quantized variants for cost; also asked about fallback to smaller model for degraded mode.
- Routing/fallback: wants automatic routing to cheaper region/model for non-sensitive tasks, and strict fallback to CPU-hosted small model for tool-only tasks.
- Security: must have SSO/SAML for console, audit logs for all API calls, KMS for key management, EU data residency for some customers. Procurement requires SOC2 docs + contract addendum for residency.
- Quote from VP Eng: "We need streaming that feels instant to agents — if the first token is slow they drop context."
- Recent POC notes: median 1.6s after cache tuning; tail 95th still ~2.4s under peak; engineering wants kernel-level batching configs and KV-cache tuning from Redwood SE.
- Action items: SE to share recommended batching/config + quickstart sample (streaming+tool-calls). AE to produce pricing worksheet for Hosted vs Dedicated (3-yr reserved vs burst). Security to deliver SOC2 + KMS integration spec. Procurement to get Dedicated sizing if hosted can't hit SLO.
- Internal next step shorthand: "POC: run 72h test at 2x expected concurrency, gather token-level traces, Redwood SE provide tuning guide, then sync w/ procurement."
